thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-runtime-5xx spike detected in us-west-2 (elevated 502/504s, timeouts). Triggered by increased segfaults on model-runner nodes.
Alex K: seeing ~18% 5xx on /v1/generate, errors mostly SIGSEGV in model-runner. stacktrace points at quantized attention kernel.
Maria R: confirmed customer-facing errors on a few key tenants, some timed out at 30s. Telemetry shows KVCACHE growth before crash.
Samir P: rolling back quantized kernel patch that went out 02:12UTC? that was on canary earlier.
Taylor (oncall): I'm on it. Is there a safe fallback we can route to while we triage? pinging Eng Runtime.
Eng Runtime: we can reroute affected routes to non-quantized model variant (same weights, different kernel). Will push policy to gateway. Doing now.
Ops Bot: routing-policy update: route /v1/generate for tag=prod -> model: rwd/instruct-small:nonquant (prioritize region mirror).
Alex K: traffic shifted, error rate dropped to ~4% in 30s. Some persistent 504s during in-flight requests.
SRE Lead: start mitigation checklist: 1) reroute (done) 2) cordon + drain suspect nodes 3) collect core dumps 4) enable livetrace. Assigning tasks.
Taylor (oncall): cordoning nodes now: nodes nl-runner-03..05.
Maria R: collecting core dumps from nl-runner-04, attaching to gist in a sec.
Support: customer-impact: listed customers A,B,C on the affected shard. Notified via incident status page and opened priority support tickets.
Eng Runtime: quick patch: disable AVX512 kernel path as temporary mitigation. Will hotpatch runtime binary with revert of optimized path.
Alex K: stacking logs: \n```\n2026-03-17T02:19:15Z model-runner[pid=8241]: SIGSEGV at 0x7f1b2c... in quant_attn_kernel
kv_cache_size=1.2GB seq_len=2048
```\nSamir P: looks like boundary check in packed attention loop. Known risky optimization. Good to revert.
Taylor (oncall): applying hotpatch to one drained node for testing, then canary back to traffic.
Eng Runtime: hotpatch rolled to nl-runner-06 (canary), health ok. Reintroduced canary traffic (5%)-> no segfaults for 7 mins.
Alex K: we're seeing degraded latency (+120ms) but acceptable for now. 5xx back to baseline.
SRE Lead: prepare next steps: create PR to revert the opt completely, add unit test for kvcache edge, schedule kernel-slow rollout after midnight maintenance window.
Product Ops: config note: enable automatic fallback routing threshold at 7% 5xx for 2m to flip to non-quant variant. Saves manual hops.
Ops Bot: alert muted to avoid paging for the same symptom while we stabilize. Reason: active mitigation in progress.
Maria R: uploaded core dump + gdb backtrace: https://internal-gists/redwood/abc123 - please grab before TTL.
Eng Runtime: extracted stack: \n```\n#0 quant_attn_kernel+0x4f
#1 forward_attention+0x1a3
#2 model_step+0x9b
```\nSamir P: grabbing a local repro with seq_len=2048, kv growth. Running with sanitizers to confirm fix.
Taylor (oncall): handoff: I'll be off in 45m. @SRE Lead please take next oncall. Update runbook: mark quant-kernel as hazardous for high seq lengths.
SRE Lead: taking over. Action items I own: PR revert, postmortem draft, customer follow-ups.
Product Ops: drafting status update: "We mitigated production errors by routing traffic to a non-quantized model variant and rolling back a risky kernel optimization. Some customers experienced errors for ~18 minutes; no data loss."
Support: emailing impacted customers with ETA for full fix and link to status.
Alex K: will open bug with repro + tests, tag eng-runtime + triage label.
Eng Runtime: follow-up: planning to add kvcache caps and a sequence-length guard in runtime to prevent unbounded growth.
SRE Lead: summary for postmortem: root cause - unsafe optimization in quantized attention kernel causing OOB memory access under certain seq/kvcache conditions -> segfaults -> 5xx/timeouts. Mitigations: routing fallback, hotpatch revert, node drain, cordon, core dump analysis.
Taylor (oncall): leaving note in handoff channel and runbook: last state stable, 5xx <1% across regions.
Incident Bot: Incident resolved: monitoring in watch state for 2h. If 5xx > 2% for >5m, reopen.
Support: closing immediate customer tickets, will keep them updated.
Maria R: uploading final artifact: sanitized core + repro case to internal bug #INC-2026-339.
Alex K: thanks all. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
